description: Two-page Japanese delivery note (納品書) for fasteners from a fictional supplier, produced with fpdf2 2.9.0 with an embedded IPAGothic subset (TrueType, Identity-H) for all text, drawn cell by cell as a full grid with the header row repeated on page 2, a Code 39 barcode of the slip number, a logo of two squares and a red square company seal (角印) drawn with rectangles. Amounts are whole yen with commas, the discount row uses the Japanese triangle convention for negatives (△1,500), dates are written 2026年11月10日. Edits: the delivery date, the plating of one bolt (亜鉛めっき → 三価クロメート), the quantity of the M8 spring washers (200 → 250, its amount follows), the discount (△1,500 → △2,000), and the recomputed subtotal, consumption tax and total. No re-flow: page breaks are unchanged.
